Ngoài các tầng căn hộ, mặt bằng The Poet: Besides the apartment floors, The Poet Residence floor plans set aside the ground floor for the lobby, café and mini mart; the 2nd floor for a kindergarten and community room; the 3rd floor for an indoor swimming pool, gym and yoga; and the rooftop for a garden, bar and fireworks-viewing plaza. The two basements have about 92 car spaces and 353 motorbike spaces. With amenities concentrated in the podium and on the roof, the apartment floors are quieter.
